paired_native_comparison.methodology: Both frozen libraries loaded by separate ffi.load handles in one OpenResty process; same pre-read bytes, alternating order, 3 warmup pairs plus trial 0 discarded, 63 measured pairs per cell; CPU timer includes source construction/scanner selection/feed/finish but not release or Lua loading/encoding; pinned virtual CPU 0. Native-only corroboration, not the full Lua benchmark.
paired_native_comparison.driver_source:
local ffi, cjson = require("ffi"), require("cjson")
require("leanjson.lib")
local libs = {previous=ffi.load("/workspace/target/native-string-loop/baseline.so"), current=ffi.load("/workspace/target/release/libleanjson.so")}
local records={}
for _, fixture in ipairs {"wide-scalars-32768", "wide-objects-32768"} do
 local f=assert(io.open("/tmp/"..fixture..".json","rb")); local raw=f:read("*a"); f:close()
 local ptr=ffi.cast("const uint8_t *",raw)
 for _, mode in ipairs {"memory","feed"} do
  for trial=-3,63 do
   local order=trial%2==0 and {"previous","current"} or {"current","previous"}
   for _,name in ipairs(order) do
    collectgarbage("collect"); local lib=libs[name]
    local opts=ffi.new("leanjson_source_v2_options",{api_version=2,mode=3,max_depth=1024,window_size=65536,index_depth=3,index_array_limit=3,index_budget_bytes=1048576})
    local began=os.clock(); local s=assert(lib.leanjson_source_v2_new(opts,nil)); assert(lib.leanjson_source_v2_set_scanner(s,1,nil)==0)
    for first=0,#raw-1,65536 do
     local n=math.min(65536,#raw-first)
     local status=mode=="memory" and lib.leanjson_source_v2_feed_memory(s,ptr,#raw,first,n,nil) or lib.leanjson_source_v1_feed(s,first,ptr+first,n,nil)
     assert(status==2)
    end
    local status=mode=="memory" and lib.leanjson_source_v2_finish_memory(s,ptr,#raw,nil) or lib.leanjson_source_v1_finish(s,#raw,nil); assert(status==0)
    local elapsed=os.clock()-began; lib.leanjson_source_v1_release(s)
    if trial>0 then records[#records+1]={fixture=fixture,source=mode,trial=trial,artifact=name,cpu_ms=elapsed*1000} end
   end
  end
 end
end
print(cjson.encode(records))

limitations: Strict peak RSS gate remains failed for wide scalar objects: 6/66 paired cells; thresholds unchanged.

Independent-process wide-container comparisons remain noisy; pinned repeats show +10.8% memory/+26.3% feed for wide objects, while same-process native pairs show -1.8%/-1.5%. Native-only comparison cannot prove no Lua-path regression.
Incremental feed still runs a diagnostic pass and includes Lua substring/feed overhead; CJSON comparator always decodes complete memory.
CJSON does not perform Schema validation; Schema benchmark columns do not represent equal work.
Lua output assembly and full string reads still allocate Lua strings; no all-Rust string ownership claim.
Docker Linux ARM64 only in this task; no new x86/macOS runtime, actual Miri execution, Kong load test or end-to-end SLO proof.
